planning_notes: Hardware wiring is limited to the explicitly stated A0 potentiometer input and D9 PWM LED output; no other functional wiring or serial requirements are specified.

PWM brightness mapping (e.g., scaling from ADC range to PWM duty cycle) is handled in the SysML model; analog_input and pwm_output are declared without scale/offset calibration keys (using legal catalog defaults).
No serial reporting or serial input commands are required by the provided requirements, so serial_channels is empty.
Control period is set to 10 ms as a practical scheduling granularity since no deadline/timing constraints were stated.
